artworks.title: Pink Roses
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: In this painting, a bouquet of large, pale pink roses fills a green vase decorated with yellow floral patterns, which is resting on a wooden table with a rich, dark brown surface. Flowers extend outward from the center to fill much of the upper portion of the image, while the wooden surface stretches diagonally from the bottom left corner to the center. The pink roses are surrounded by green leaves and smaller groups of yellow flowers. The wall behind the flowers is a pale gray color.

artworks.title: Basket of Fruit
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Fruit on a Tray
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a large cut watermelon in a woven basket surrounded by various fruits including grapes, peaches, and small round red fruits. The color palette includes greens, blues, oranges, and browns. The basket takes up most of the space and is filled with fruits, with grape clusters hanging above it.

artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait miniature of a man's upper body in profile facing left. The man has defined facial features, a prominent nose, sideburns, dark hair in waves, and wears formal attire with a high, white collar and gold buttons. The background is solid black with a gold oval border around the man.

artworks.title: The Biglin Brothers Racing
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Cornelius Vanderbilt Whitney
artworks.description: Two men with pale skin, wearing white sleeveless shirts and royal-blue caps, row in unison in a long, narrow boat on a placid blue river in this horizontal landscape painting. The low, honey-colored wooden boat extends off both sides of the canvas. Both men face our left as they row to our right. The man in front looks ahead of him, beyond the stern of the boat, and the man to our right, closer to the bow, tucks his chin down to look past his shoulder. Their bare, muscled arms are extended straight as the two oars sweep back. The tip of another boat runs close and parallel to the bottom edge of the composition, spanning the left three-quarters of the painting. The opposite riverbank is lined with a dense forest of pine-green trees. People crowd along the decks of a steamboat and a paddleboat near the riverbank to our left. Another narrow skuller, rowed by four people wearing ruby-red shirts, cuts through the water at the back center of the river. The riverbank beyond is lined with people, painted with strokes of black and white, and minuscule touches of red. The horizon comes halfway up the composition. Cream-white clouds float across a muted, topaz-blue sky above the trees.

artworks.title: Violet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Augustus Vincent Tack
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a young girl with fair complexion and light brown, textured hair. She is wearing a textured garment, possibly in brown tones, with a white collar. The background is dark, contrasting with her features and clothing. The painting is signed "Violet" and dated "Sept 1882" in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Agnes Gordon Cochran Higginson (Mrs. Stephen Higginson)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Augustus Vincent Tack
artworks.description: The image displays a head-and-shoulders portrait of a person seated and facing slightly to the left. The individual has a fair complexion with soft facial features, including gentle eyes, a prominent nose, and light-colored lips. Their hair is curly and short, with a light brown hue, and is partially covered by a modest cap with a soft fabric tied at the back, which appears to be of the same texture as their neck scarf. The person is wearing what appears to be a dark-colored coat over a lighter garment, possibly a high-collared blouse or shirt, with a cream-colored scarf draped elegantly around the neck. There is no visible jewelry or other items being held. The background is a dark, plain canvas.

artworks.title: Marina Piccola, Capri
artworks.dimensions:

artworks.description: This painting shows a coastal scene with wooden rowboats on a sandy, rocky shore.  A white cloth and several ropes rest on the boat in the center, and two other boats are in a row behind it. On the left, brown stone structures are partially visible, with one in the background appearing to have been carved out of a rocky formation. A small figure is visible atop this structure, tending to what may be a clothesline. The rocks stretch across the painting, with some areas of bright, green-blue ocean visible around them. Small boats appear to sail on the water far in the distance. The light blue sky dominates the upper half of the painting, filled with puffy white clouds.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.artist: Follower of Louis Michel Van Loo
artworks.description: Shown from the chest up, a woman with smooth, pale, peachy-toned skin wearing a carnation-pink and white gown looks at us from this vertical portrait painting. The woman’s shoulders are angled to our left, but she turns her head and tips it to our right to look at us with brown eyes under curving, gray brows. She has an oval face with a straight nose, a hint of a double chin, and her full pink lips are closed in a slight smile. Her ash-brown hair is pulled up and back and curls across the top of her head around pink and white ribbons pleated to resemble flowers. Her square-necked, low-cut bodice is lined with lace across her pale decolletage. The fabric is patterned with thinner white stripes and wider dark pink stripes. A choker tight around her neck has a pink ribbon edged with white lace and tied into a bow at the front of her throat. The necklace is tied on with a white bow at the back of her neck. She wears a gold ring on the fourth finger of her left hand, which is closer to us. On that wrist, four strands of white pearls hold a miniature oval portrait of a pale-skinned person. The woman holds a gold and emerald-green compact with that hand, and the other rests on an aquamarine-blue cushion or cloth in front of her at chest height. She pinches something brown between those fingers, and a few specks of brown are in the box. She sits in a wooden chair upholstered with moss green on the back. A curtain or other swath of muted purple fabric is to the left, and the wall behind her has chair-rail molding and is painted soft leaf green.

artworks.title: Daniel Webster
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a person seated in a slightly turned position, looking directly at the viewer. The person has distinctive facial features, including a strong brow, deep-set eyes, a straight nose, and a firm mouth. Their hair is dark and receding, with tufts visible on the sides. They wear a formal outfit with a high-collared white shirt, a cravat, and a dark suit with wide lapels and two visible buttons. The background is plain, dark, and subtly gradient, emphasizing the person in the foreground. There is no jewelry or objects held by the person. The artwork is done in a classic, historical style against an indistinct brown backdrop.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Quaker
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a three-quarter view portrait. He is looking at the viewer, showing his face and upper body. The man has a round face with gentle features, fair skin, and white hair styled in 18th-century fashion. He is wearing a dark coat with gold buttons, a light waistcoat, and a white cravat with ruffled edges. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Henry Eichholtz Leman
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body in a classic portrait pose. He faces forward, looking at the viewer. The man has facial features like fair complexion, a smooth face, warm brown eyes, and styled hair with a slight wave and a side part. He wears formal attire with a dark jacket, white shirt, black waistcoat, and a black bow tie. The background is a plain, muted color with no visible jewelry or objects.

artworks.title: William Constable
artworks.description: Shown from the chest up, a pale-skinned, clean-shaven man wearing a sapphire-blue coat over a white cravat looks out from this vertical portrait painting. The man’s body is angled to our left, but he turns his face to look at us from the corners of his gray eyes. His smooth cheeks are flushed, and he smiles slightly. His white hair, probably a wig, sweeps back from his forehead and curls over his ears. His snow-white cravat is tied in a bow, and the pointed ends of the fabric fall over the wide lapels of his coat. The man is lit from our right, and a sheen on the high collar suggests velvet. Brass buttons gleam on the front of the coat. The background lightens from dark brown across the top to pale fawn brown along the bottom.

artworks.title: Sir John Dick
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting, facing slightly to the right. He has fair skin, a straight nose, and white, slightly curly hair styled in an 18th-century manner. He wears a navy blue coat with gold embellishments, a white shirt with a ruffled collar, a red sash, and a star-shaped badge. A medallion hangs around his neck. The man is seated at a table with a document in front of him, holding a quill pen. The background is neutral.

artworks.title: The Fire Boss
artworks.description: This painting depicts a man seated on a dark surface with his body facing the left, looking out at us from under the brim of his hat. He has light skin and a white mustache, and he wears dark clothing and white shoes. His gray cap has a golden headlamp on it, and a pipe is clamped in his thin, downturned mouth. His hands are dirty, covered in streaks of black and gray, and he holds a silver pail with a metal container on it. The background is a blend of black, gray, and dark blue.

artworks.title: Queen Victoria
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the children of the late William H. Donner
artworks.description: This painting depicts a woman in a three-quarter view, capturing her upper body, arms, and voluminous dress. She has her body turned to the left but is looking directly at us with a neutral expression. Her skin is pale, her eyes are blue, and her slightly parted lips are red. Her hair is styled in a middle part and gathered in two braids that lead into a bun, around which is a silver crown or tiara. She wears an ornate gown with a fitted white bodice adorned with lace and silver embellishments on the sleeves. Across her chest is a dark blue sash that has two rows of small gems. Her hands are crossed near her waist, and she holds a pink rose with green leaves in one hand. Her arms also gather up the long lace train of her white skirt. She wears a gold pendant around her neck. The background of the painting shows a dramatic sky filled with large yellow and green clouds.

artworks.title: Moonlight
artworks.description: This painting shows a cluster of trees against a bright sky in shades of pale yellow and pale seafoam green. Closest to us, a green-gray path stretches horizontally next to tall teal and blue grasses. The gray shadow of a tall tree crosses over the path. The trees occupy the top two-thirds of the painting, and they are painted in shades of blue-green, gray, pale yellow, lilac, and a pale, reddish-pink hue. Near the top right corner, a pale-yellow light source is visible through the leaves and branches of the tree in the center. The brushstrokes in the painting are visible, and the short strokes of thick paint all go in the same direction. These brushstrokes, combined with the seafoam-green color palette, give the painting a soft, hazy look.

artworks.title: The Artist's Garden
artworks.description: Neat, tended garden rows stretch away from us toward a band of trees in this horizontal landscape painting. Low plants grow across the middle of the scene, and higher plants are staked on poles to the right. A fence runs alongside the garden to the left, and a few structures are tucked among the trees’ bushy canopies. Two white chimneys are outlined against the watery blue sky on the far side of the tree line. The plants are painted with visible dabs of copper brown and ivory white, and the dark trees are highlighted with more white glints. The entire scene is backlit and shadowy, though, making details about the buildings, which might include a shed, gate, and house, hard to make out. Thin white clouds skim across the sky. Traces of a signature in red paint are visible in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Snow in New York
artworks.description: A snowy street with a horse and carriage is flanked to each side by tall buildings in this vertical painting. The overcast scene is loosely painted with visible brushstrokes throughout, so some details are difficult to make out. The buildings to each side are painted in tones of coffee and earth brown along the street, and oatmeal brown and slate gray for the buildings farther from us. Two-story houses with steps leading down to the street line the composition to each side, and the taller buildings beyond stretch off the top edge of the canvas. Closest to us and to our right, the horse and carriage move away from us. Painted with a few strokes in black, golden yellow, and crimson red, people walk or stand along both sides of the street. A single lamppost stands about halfway back along the street to our left. The globe dangles from the curved top of the lamppost. The snow is painted in tones of ivory and cream white. In the distance, the sky between the buildings is parchment brown. The artist signed and dated the painting in the lower left corner, “Robert Henri Mar 5 1902.”

artworks.title: The Laundresses
artworks.description: This is a painting of a dim street with several people carrying sacks. The people wear long skirts and aprons in dark colors, and their large sacks are filled with white cloth. The people are bent over under the weight of the sacks. They walk across a cobblestone street in front of a building with a lit interior and blue wallpaper. On the right side of the painting is another street with more buildings and a carriage where people appear to pass up their sacks to a person on top.

artworks.title: Possibly Franciska Krasinska, Duchess of Courland
artworks.dimensions:
overall (painted oval): 62.9 x 49.5 cm (24 3/4 x 19 1/2 in.)
framed: 72.4 x 57.8 x 3.2 cm (28 1/2 x 22 3/4 x 1 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The portrait depicts the upper half of a woman's body. She is posed facing slightly to the side, with her head tilted and gaze averted. The woman has soft facial features, fair skin, rosy cheeks, and a subtle smile. Her brown curly hair is styled with volume on top and falls over her shoulder, and she wears a dark headband. She is dressed in a light gown with intricate details, set against a softly painted sky background with light clouds.

artworks.title: Italian Woman (La Morieri)
artworks.description: This painting shows a woman sitting, her body facing the left and her head turned to look at us, with one arm resting on a wooden surface on the right. She has dark hair partially covered by a bright yellow scarf or cap, light skin, deep-set eyes, pale eyebrows, and thin lips set in a neutral expression. She wears a white blouse with wide sleeves that is partially covered by a black bodice with a wide red neckline. Her skirt is black, although in the front she appears to be covered by a blanket or apron with colorful abstract designs in red, tan, and green, with some horizontal black stripes. She also wears large silver hoop earrings, multiple silver necklaces, and a silver ring on her hand. The background is a blend of muted green and brown tones, with a hint of pale blue in the upper left corner.
